Heo Rừng Con cào chân rồi húc thẳng một: Boar Piglet paws the ground, then charges far in a straight line: sidestep; if it hits a wall it is stunned, strike now.
Bầy Ong Vò Vẽ bay vòng quanh rồi bổ vào: Wasp Swarm circles you, then dives in 3 times along red lines: when you see a line, step sideways out of it.
Bọ Hung lăn cục đất thẳng theo vạch đỏ:: Dung Beetle rolls a dirt ball along the red line: step off the line, then circle behind it to attack.
Hoa Phun Bào Tử bắn ba hạt rơi xuống vòn: Spore Flower lobs 3 seeds into red circles that leave poison puddles: leave the circles, don't stand in puddles.
Chồn Bóng biến mất rồi hiện sau lưng bạn: Shadow Weasel vanishes and reappears behind you at the red circle: roll away from it, then turn and hit.
Nấm Phồng phồng to rồi nổ, để lại mây độ: Puffshroom swells, then bursts into a poison cloud for 3s: run out of the red circle, stay out of the cloud.
Sóc ném hạt dẻ nảy một lần rồi nổ ở vòng: Squirrel tosses a chestnut that bounces once and blows in the red circle behind you: step aside or toward the squirrel.
Nhím Gai Độc cuộn tròn rồi lăn theo vạch: Venom Hedgehog curls up and rolls along the red line, bouncing off a wall once: avoid both lines.
Cua Lính chờ ngang hàng rồi lướt ngang t: Crab lines up with you, then scuttles sideways to pinch: don't stay in its row, move up or down.
Bầy Cá Con bơi lượn sóng theo vạch đỏ, q: Fish School swims a wavy red path, then comes back once: dodge the path both times.
Ốc Mượn Hồn bị đánh thì rút vỏ, không ăn: Hermit Snail hides in its shell when hit and takes no damage, then leaves slowing slime: wait for it to come out, avoid the slime.
Hải Quỳ bắn ba tia nước hình quạt theo v: Sea Anemone shoots 3 water jets in a fan along red lines; up close its tentacles sweep: stand between lines or back off.
Cá Chuồn vọt lên rồi đáp xuống vòng đỏ d: Flying Fish leaps up and lands on the red circle under you: when you see the circle, run out.
Cá Nóc hút bạn lại gần rồi nổ 8 gai theo: Pufferfish pulls you in, then bursts 8 spikes along 8 lines: run away and stand between two lines.
Sứa Bom thả vũng điện, vòng đỏ đầy là vũ: Bomb Jelly drops an electric puddle; when the red circle fills it flashes, shocks and stuns: don't stand in it as it fills.
Nhím Biển bắn gai xoáy ốc: luồn qua khe: Sea Urchin fires spikes in a spiral: slip through the gap between the arms, don't stand close.
Lính Ma đánh dấu chỗ sau lưng bạn rồi hi: Ghost Soldier marks a spot behind you, then appears there and slashes: step off the red line.
Bầy Dơi Than bổ nhào hình chữ V, trúng t: Coal Bats dive in a V shape and heal when they hit: avoid both red lines.
Tượng Đá đứng im, lại gần thì đập đất, s: Stone Statue stands still; get close and it slams the ground, rings spread out: back off after hitting, or roll through.
Đèn Lồng Ma bắn lửa ma đuổi theo bạn 3 g: Ghost Lantern fires a fireball that chases you for 3s: slash it to pop it, or run circles until it fades.
Mèo Đen tạo hai bóng ảo: chỉ con thật ăn: Black Cat makes two phantoms: only the real one takes hits; phantoms dash and vanish, dodge their red lines.
Hũ Lửa lăn tới rồi vỡ, để lại vệt lửa 2: Fire Jar rolls in and shatters, leaving a fire trail for 2s: avoid the red line and the red circle at its end.
Tiểu Yêu đặt ba lá bùa thành tam giác qu: Imp places 3 charms in a triangle around you, then the whole triangle blows: run out of the triangle.
Nhím Than Hồng làm gai lửa trồi từ đất t: Ember Hedgehog makes fire spikes erupt in a row toward you: step sideways off the row of red circles.
Mỗi vùng quái con đánh một kiểu riêng. R: Each land's small monsters fight their own way. Old Forest: straight charges, rolling dirt balls, spore rain, sneaking behind you, poison cloud bursts. Sea Cave: sideways pinches, shells and slowing slime, pulling you in, electric puddles, spiral spikes. Old Castle: blink slashes, phantoms, chasing ghost fire, charm triangles, erupting fire spikes. Every attack shows a red line or circle first: see it, dodge it. Shield monsters still guard their front and heal allies; ranged ones still call swarms.
Rái Cá chống sào nhảy xuống vòng đỏ chỗ: Pole Otter vaults onto the red circle where you stand: run out of it. If it misses, it's dazed: hit it now.
Bầy Đỉa nhổm lên rồi lao bám chân bạn là: Leeches rear up and latch onto your legs, slowing and draining you: roll to shake them off.
Ba Ba có mai chắn phía trước, rụt cổ rồi: The turtle's shell guards its front. It pulls in its neck, then snaps along the red line: dodge, then hit its back right after the snap.
Cóc Tía phun ba bọt rơi xuống vòng đỏ th: Bubble Toad spits three bubbles onto red circles that become poison puddles, and hops back if you get close: leave the circles, stay out of puddles.
Rắn Nước lặn xuống, gợn nước chạy ra sau: Water Snake dives, its ripple sneaks behind you, then it bites from the red circle: when the ripple comes, move away. It can't dive on stone floor.
Ếch Phình phình to rồi nảy tới nổ ở vòng: Puff Frog swells up, hops in and bursts on the red circle: run away. Pop it early and it blasts nearby monsters instead.
Ma Da ném bầu nước, chỗ rơi thành xoáy n: River Imp throws a water gourd that becomes a whirlpool, pulls you in, then splashes: run out of the red circle against the pull.
Trai Sông Gai khép vỏ thì không ăn đòn p: A closed clam shrugs off hits from the front; when it opens, it shoots five bouncing pearls along the red lines: dodge them, attack from behind.
Rái Cá Thủ Lĩnh quăng lưới vào vòng đỏ:: Otter Chief throws a net onto the red circle: run out of it. If netted, tap Dodge repeatedly to wriggle free, then avoid the torch's fire cone.
Cóc Tía Chúa thè lưỡi theo vạch đỏ kéo b: Purple Toad King's tongue follows the red line and pulls you in, then it stomps its lotus pad: if pulled, roll out of the circle. Bubble Rain lands in a ring around you: stay still in the middle, but step out once it's enraged.
